descriptions.text: God of Blacksmithery and Armor Ogun. Level 250. This god is not sponsored. Warning: This is a deity. He is invulnerable on this floor. This god has been temporarily summoned to this location. Summoning rules apply. He's here now because Ogun strongly believes all punishments should be handed out in person.

recap.text: Carl, Donut, Paz, Anton, and Sister Ines flag a ghommid splitter named Skylar Spinach to reach Asojano's shrine. Ogun, the god of blacksmiths, orders Paz and Anton to fix his shrine, but Bomo repairs Yemaya's instead. Ogun enters the realm and kills Anton, who was shielded by Black Nimbus. Sister Ines turns Paz into a card.

beats.headline: A quest from their own god
beats.text: Crawler Carl, Princess Donut, Paz, Anton and Sister Ines get themselves to Asojano's shrine intact, which required flagging a ghommid splitter named Skylar Spinach and a certain amount of nerve. Asojano begins a ritual. And in the middle of it, Paz and Anton receive a quest from Ogun, who is their god: only one shrine down here can be fixed, and he would like it to be his. Note the position those two men are now in. Note who put them in it.
beats.gist: Ogun asks Paz and Anton to fix his shrine.

beats.headline: The shrine they did not pick
beats.text: Deities appear from every direction, each of them making a case for their own shrine, which is the single worst committee meeting I have ever had to render. Then Katia Grim messages Carl: repair Yemaya's shrine or lose her and the cat to the Crown of the Sepsis Whore. So Bomo repairs Yemaya's. The ghommid settlement is freed, Carl walks away with slugpox and a card made out of Asojano, and Ogun enters the realm to punish his worshippers. Not the crawlers who chose. His own.
beats.gist: Deities argue over shrines until Bomo repairs Yemaya's to save Katia Grim and the cat.

beats.headline: The outsider at the anvil
beats.text: The file, for the people about to meet him. Ogun is an outsider, one of the old gods, from an obscure pantheon that has dissipated into time, and until a minute ago he was the last surviving member of it. He spends his days at a celestial anvil, angrily making armour, piece after piece, and nobody knows why he does it or where the armour goes. It is said the pieces are a strange shape, all of them cut for four-legged beasts. He is a god of blacksmiths and armourers now. He was something considerably larger once, and his power and his ambition make him a real contender for the throne of heaven.
beats.gist: Ogun is a blacksmith god and former larger entity who makes four-legged armor at a celestial anvil.

beats.headline: Punishment, in person
beats.text: Ogun puts a debuff on Paz that nothing down here can heal. Crawler Carl throws Black Nimbus over Anton to shield him, and Ogun kills Anton instead, and leaves the realm having taken exactly what he came for. Paz, going, spends his last minutes telling Carl and Donut two things about Sister Ines: her race makes everyone near her want to protect her, and it gets stronger the longer they are near her, and before the crawl she was a murderer. Sister Ines turns Paz into a card rather than lose him.
beats.gist: Ogun puts an unhealable debuff on Paz, kills Anton, and leaves the realm.
